verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law, tax and notary firm. User-configurable background automations are a category error for this kind of professional-services provider. The evidence mentions internally used legal tech, digital workflows and AI-based systems, and a software-supported unit for transparency-register filings. None of these is a client-facing automation capability that a user could set up, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
